name: firstlight-engine
description: Optional dependencies for the engine. Every script here runs on bare Node with ffmpeg and nothing else — this file exists for ONE opt-in feature: engine/claude_agent.mjs calling the Claude API directly instead of writing an agent packet. Skip `npm install` and the pipeline still works end to end; claude_agent.mjs just writes packets for a reviewer (human or agent session) rather than calling the API itself.
